title: Care-foregoing persistence aligns with a worse health surface while work status moves differently

observations.period: 2024 to 2025; no listed care foregoing to no listed care foregoing

denominator.unit: recontacted respondents with complete E1_a-E1_e in both years

observations.method: Link 2024 and 2025 records by shedid; any Yes among E1_a-E1_e defines care foregoing; health is pph10001 in {Fair,Poor}, employment is ppemploy=Not working; use 2025 panel_weight.
observations.uncertainty: Longitudinal descriptive transition with no dated bill, causal order, treatment continuity, or replicate-weight standard errors.
observations.counterinterpretation: Health and work composition may precede and influence reported care choices; no listed foregoing does not prove no unmet need.

observations.period: 2024 to 2025; no listed care foregoing to any listed care foregoing

denominator.unit: recontacted respondents with complete E1_a-E1_e in both years

observations.method: Link 2024 and 2025 records by shedid; any Yes among E1_a-E1_e defines care foregoing; health is pph10001 in {Fair,Poor}, employment is ppemploy=Not working; use 2025 panel_weight.
observations.uncertainty: Longitudinal descriptive transition with no dated bill, causal order, treatment continuity, or replicate-weight standard errors; entry cell is smaller.
observations.counterinterpretation: Entry may reflect changing need, access, recall, or cost; it does not establish a new medical event or a care-caused health change.

observations.period: 2024 to 2025; any listed care foregoing to no listed care foregoing

denominator.unit: recontacted respondents with complete E1_a-E1_e in both years

observations.method: Link 2024 and 2025 records by shedid; any Yes among E1_a-E1_e defines care foregoing; health is pph10001 in {Fair,Poor}, employment is ppemploy=Not working; use 2025 panel_weight.
observations.uncertainty: Longitudinal descriptive transition with no dated bill, causal order, treatment continuity, or replicate-weight standard errors; exit cell is smaller.

observations.period: 2024 to 2025; any listed care foregoing to any listed care foregoing

denominator.unit: recontacted respondents with complete E1_a-E1_e in both years

observations.method: Link 2024 and 2025 records by shedid; any Yes among E1_a-E1_e defines care foregoing; health is pph10001 in {Fair,Poor}, employment is ppemploy=Not working; use 2025 panel_weight.

boundary: These health and work associations do not establish the bill, need, amount, alternative, treatment continuity, recovery, institutional remedy, trust, or political action.
